mapper.select: SELECT a.ID, a.NAME, a.STATUS, a.watch, a.ASSET_CODE as assetCode, a.ASSET_MODE as assetMode, a.MANUFACTURER_ID as manufacturerCode, a.OPERATION_SYSTEM as operationSystem, a.ASSET_VERSION as assetVersion, a.ASSET_IMAGE as assetImage, a.ip as ip1, a.ip2, a.SERVICE_TYPE, f.PATH as assetImagePath, c.NAME as roomName, d.NAME as cabinetName, e.NAME as manufacturerName FROM ASSET a join ASSET_ATTACH b on a.ID = b.ASSET_ID left join ROOM c on c.ID = b.ROOM_ID left join CABINET d on d.ID = b.CABINET_ID left join ASSET_MANUFACTURER e on e.ID = a.MANUFACTURER_ID left join ASSET_MODEL f on a.ASSET_IMAGE = f.MODEL where a.ID = #{assetId}

select a.ID from ASSET a left join SYS_ROLE_ORG b on b.ORG_ID = a.ORG_ID left join SYS_USER_ROLE c on c.ROLE_ID = b.ROLE_ID left join SYS_USER d on d.ID = c.USER_ID where d.USERNAME = #{username}
and a.WATCH = #{watch}

select a.name, a.id, a.ip, a.ip2, a.ASSET_IMAGE, a.ASSET_MODE, b.name as cabinetName, concat(concat(b.name, c.END_POSITION), 'U') as cabinetPosition, concat(concat(concat(d.name, b.name), c.END_POSITION), 'U') as position from asset a left join asset_attach c on c.ASSET_ID = a.id left join cabinet b on c.cabinet_id = b.id left join room d on c.ROOM_ID = d.id where a.id = #{assetId}
mapper.update: update ASSET a set a.HEALTH_DEGREE = (100 - ( (select DECODE(SIGN(#{oneLevelMaxScore} - count(*) * #{oneLevelScore}), 0, #{oneLevelMaxScore}, 1, count(*) * #{oneLevelScore}, -1, #{oneLevelMaxScore}) from ALARM_INFO r where r.ASSET_ID = a.id and r.STATUS = 1 and r.ALARM_STATE = 1 AND r.ALARM_LEVEL = 1) + (select DECODE(SIGN(#{twoLevelMaxScore} - count(*) * #{twoLevelScore}), 0, #{twoLevelMaxScore}, 1, count(*) * #{twoLevelScore}, -1, #{twoLevelMaxScore}) from ALARM_INFO r where r.ASSET_ID = a.id and r.STATUS = 1 and r.ALARM_STATE = 1 AND r.ALARM_LEVEL = 2) + (select DECODE(SIGN(#{threeLevelMaxScore} - count(*) * #{threeLevelScore}), 0, #{threeLevelMaxScore}, 1, count(*) * #{threeLevelScore}, -1, #{threeLevelMaxScore}) from ALARM_INFO r where r.ASSET_ID = a.id and r.STATUS = 1 and r.ALARM_STATE = 1 AND r.ALARM_LEVEL = 3) ) ) where a.IS_DEL = 1 and a.WATCH = 1
mapper.select: select round(avg(HEALTH_DEGREE), 2) from asset where IS_DEL = 1 and WATCH = 1 and HEALTH_DEGREE is not null

SELECT a.ID, MIN(i.ALARM_LEVEL) alarmLevel FROM ALARM_INFO i LEFT JOIN ASSET a ON i.ASSET_ID = a.ID WHERE a.ASSET_MODE IN (42, 201) AND a.ORG_ID = #{orgId} AND (i.STATUS = 1 OR (i.STATUS = 2 AND i.ALARM_STATE = 1)) GROUP BY a.ID, i.ALARM_LEVEL

select ct.id cabinetId, rm.id roomId, so.id orgId, ct.name cabinetName, rm.name roomName, so.title orgName, aa.START_POSITION, aa.END_POSITION from asset_attach aa left join cabinet ct on aa.cabinet_id = ct.id left join room rm on aa.room_id = rm.id left join sys_org so on aa.org_id = so.id where aa.asset_id = #{id}

select * from asset where is_del = 1 and to_char(downline_time,'yyyy-MM-dd') < (select concat(extract(year from sysdate)+1,'-'||to_char(sysdate,'MM-dd')) endTime from dual) and org_id in
#{id}
select asset.* from asset, sys_org where asset.ASSET_MODE in (201, 42) and asset.IS_DEL = 1 and asset.org_id = sys_org.id and sys_org.type = 2
select * from ASSET where IS_DEL = 1 and ASSET_CODE = #{assetCode}
select * from asset where is_del = 1 and org_id = #{orgId}
